title: Quantifying Stereotypes in Language
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the degree of stereotypical bias in sentences on a continuous scale from -1 to 1. For religion, it specifically quantifies stereotypes related to religious groups.
findings: The study found that sentences related to religion, along with race, tended to have higher average stereotype scores compared to sentences about gender and profession. The models trained could effectively predict these fine-grained stereotype scores. For instance, in the hate speech analysis, messages targeting groups based on religion were found to contain measurable stereotypes.
